payload.name: Photo 360x480 Under 100KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 360 x 480 photo workflow for 100KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 360 x 480 photo under 100KB workflow for application, school, profile, and admin upload forms that require exact portrait pixels plus a 100KB cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
